Package Publisher

package Publisher
Publisher management system package.

This package provides classes for managing a game publisher including:

  • Game catalog management (Spiel)
  • Customer purchases (Purchase)
  • Subscription management (Abo)
  • Bundle offerings (Bundle)
  • Publisher sales tracking (PublisherSale)

The main entry point is the Publisher class which orchestrates all game and customer management operations.

Author:
Jame Bayerl, Anton Hackner
